question.text: The negation of the statement “If I will become famous then I will open a school” is

options.text: I will become famous and I will not open a school
Either I will not become famous or I will not open a school.
Neither I will become famous nor I will open a school.
I will not become famous or I will open a school.

solution.text:
Let, p: I will become famous
q: I will open a school
Negation of p→q is ~p→q=p∧~q
i.e. I will become famous and I will not open a school.
